{ "rules": [
    "Model forecasts are consistently too high, showing mean-reversion bias that underestimates true price persistence",
    "Sentiment positive ( >0.5) correlates with above-model prices, while negative sentiment predicts prices below forecasts",
    "The gap between model and true outcomes increases with horizon, showing forecast lag that accelerates over time",
    "Recent price history dominates over longer-term trends, making 7+ day ahead forecasts particularly unreliable",
    "Sentiment momentum matters: sustained positive sentiment (3+ consecutive positive readings) strengthens prices beyond individual signal prediction",
    "Model fails to capture price level dependencies, producing forecasts that are too close to recent means when true prices exhibit momentum",
    "Sentiment extremes ( >0.8 or <0.2) have stronger price impact than model linear mapping suggests" ] }
